limits: Three mixed samples per mode and count; observed p95 equals the maximum and is not stable tail evidence.

Modes use one frozen release binary, eight model slots, four job slots and matching remaining hard resource ceilings.
One isolated shared registry per invocation; groups reuse registry state, so cold versus learned starts are not isolated.
Own-process CPU and I/O are measured after parking through final replay/view checks, exclude child CPU, and may omit cached I/O.
RSS is sampled, summed shared pages can be counted twice, and process-tree peaks are separate observations.
This matrix precedes the final prepared-config rejection guard; benchmarked configurations do not mutate prepared ceilings.
No safe static sweep, changing pressure/quota workload, instrumentation overhead or idle CPU acceptance is established by this matrix.
